items.title: Football Home Game Against Eastern Michigan Shifted to 6 p.m.
items.summary: KALAMAZOO, Mich. -- The Western Michigan football game against Eastern Michigan at Stafford-Smith Field at Waldo Stadium on Tuesday, Nov. 17 has been moved to 6 p.m.

items.title: Broncos Roll Past Akron, 42-14
items.summary: AKRON, Ohio -- The Western Michigan football team picked up its seventh win of the season after drubbing Akron, 42-14 on the road at InfoCision Stadium on Tuesday night.

items.title: Football Opens #MACtion on the Road at Akron on Tuesday
items.summary: Western Michigan opens mid-week #MACtion on Tuesday night, heading on the road to take on Akron at 7 p.m. The game can be watched live on CBS Sports Network and heard live on the Bronco Media Network.

items.title: Broncos Bowl Eligible After Downing Bowling Green
items.summary: KALAMAZOO, Mich. -- The Western Michigan football team earned bowl eligibility for the third-straight season after the Broncos defeated Bowling Green, 23-10, at Stafford-Smith Field at Waldo Stadium on Saturday.

items.title: Football Hosts Bowling Green for Halloween Showdown
items.summary: The Western Michigan welcomes Bowling Green for a Mid-American Conference showdown on Saturday at 12 p.m. The game can be watched live on CBS Sports Network and heard live on the Bronco Media Network.

items.title: WMU's Comeback Falls Short at Toledo
items.summary: TOLEDO, Ohio -- The Western Michigan football team's comeback effort fell short on Saturday, falling at Toledo, 45-38.

items.title: Football Faces Tough Road Battle at Toledo
items.summary: Western Michigan heads to Toledo to take on the Rockets on Saturday at 12 p.m. on CBS Sports Network. The game can be also heard live on the Bronco Media Network.

items.title: Broncos Keep Victory Cannon After 21-14 Road Win at Central Michigan
items.summary: MOUNT PLEASANT, Mich. -- Western Michigan safety Daeh McCullough picked off Central Michigan quarterback Jadyn Glasser on the final play of the game to secure the Victory Cannon Trophy's safe return to Kalamazoo after a 21-14 win over the Chippewas at Kelly/Shorts Stadium on Saturday afternoon.

items.title: Broncos Head to Mount Pleasant for 97th Battle Against Central Michigan
items.summary: Western Michigan heads to Central Michigan for the Battle for the Victory Cannon on Saturday at 1:30 p.m. at Kelly/Shorts Stadium. The game can be watched live on ESPN+ and heard live on the Bronco Media Network.

items.title: Lowry Claims MAC Offensive Player of the Week Honors
items.summary: CLEVELAND -- Western Michigan redshirt junior quarterback Broc Lowry has been named the Mid-American Conference Offensive Player of the Week after his performance in WMU's win over Kent State on Saturday.
